en: A vintage black‑and‑white/sepia postcard view over a dense spa town nestled in a valley with wooded hills behind. Tall 19th‑century urban houses line a narrow river or canal. Along one bank runs a long colonnaded promenade filled with pedestrians; several bridges cross the water. On the hillside stand grand hotel‑like buildings and a church spire. Red printed text at the top reads "Karlsbad. Blick von der Stefanspromenade." Additional German text appears on a riverside building advertising a bank and a dentist.
